entries.361bc2ead4e1d10e: This business sells petroleum products such as gasoline, kerosene, light oil and heavy oil to dealers (stores that sell under contracts with oil wholesalers) and large-volume consumers. It also undertakes storage and shipment of petroleum products on commission from petroleum wholesalers. The subsidiary Cygnus Oil Co., Ltd. handles sales and oil depot operations, San-ai Retail Service Co., Ltd. and others handle retail sales at gas stations, and a transport subsidiary manages oil depots and handles delivery. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥516,413 million (¥560,251 million in the prior year), making it the largest business.
